item.title: Email Alerts – How to Change my Email Address
item.description: Are you a BMJ Open subscriber? If your online record contains the same email address where you receive your template-bmjj alerts, you may sign in and update your email address in your online record. After you make this change, your template-bmjj alerts will be sent to your new address. You may also update the email address of your template-bmjj and other HighWire-hosted journal email alerts from the HighWire site. If you have already created a HighWire account, you may sign in now.
